heroHeadline: Sixth Heat Dome Pushes Into Italy and the Balkans as Danube Drought Threatens to Deepen, Stalling Cernavodă Restart
heroSubtitle: EU wildfire total climbs to 634,473 hectares as fire danger shifts east into Romania and the Balkans; Romania races to finish a temporary Danube dam and divert Olt River water to cool Cernavodă's two idle reactors, while Aragón's Peñas de Riglos fire is declared stabilized at roughly 18,400 hectares after the region's largest-ever mobilization.
